response.overview: The Sister uses every available tool for her experiment and teaches what she knows to her younger brother, the Pupil, before the visit of his teacher. As the Student-Teacher journeys from the lowlands to the mountaintop, unfamiliar atmospheres draw him into an alternative conversation about silence, survival, and what cannot be spoken.
response.title: Pangakuyad Ning Pamanamdaman

release_dates.note: Philippine Film Industry Month Short Film Competition
